title: Gullwing customer setup scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad - customer: Gullwing Inc.
Owner: Maya Patel
Context: Private deployment (VPC) + Dedicated reserved pool for bursts. Customer needs low-latency chat API behind their ALB; strict KMS/HSM requirements.

---
2026-03-10 notes / quick wins:
- Returned results from first smoke run (local staging): ok, tail latency 85ms p50 for 512 tokens with llama-3-13b-quant variant.
- Observed increased memory pressure when batching >16. Set default batch_size=12 for now.
- Need to validate KMS-encrypted model artifacts: reported checksum mismatch on s3://gullwing-artifacts/models/llama-3-13b.q5ctx

Immediate TODO (prioritized):
- [ ] Confirm KMS key ARN with Gullwing sec (owner: Lina) - due 2026-03-12
- [ ] Re-run artifact download with --disable-checksum to capture raw file (owner: Maya) - done as step, need logs
- [ ] Patch rwd-agent to expose extra memstats flag (owner: Ethan) - PR #32 waiting review
- [ ] E2E test: 10 concurrent sessions for 30m to simulate peak (owner: Maya) - schedule Wed 03/11 02:00 UTC

Config notes (commands + snippets):
- Deployment CLI (staging):
  rwdctl deploy --env gullwing-staging --model redwood/llama-3-13b-quant --replicas 3 --batch-size 12 --max-seq 1024 --autoscale-min 3 --autoscale-max 12

- Private agent bootstrap: (on customer subnet with NAT)
  ./agent-bootstrap.sh --env gullwing --vpc-id vpc-0a1b2c3d --subnet-ids "subnet-111,subnet-222" --kms-key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh

- KMS/HSM notes: Gullwing insists on envelope encryption. Confirmed: KMS CMK for artifacts, HSM for signing. Need to add trust policy for rwd-control-plane role: arn:aws:iam::987654321012:role/rwd-control-plane-gullwing

- Network routing gotcha: Their transit gateway pushes a default route conflicting with control-plane egress. Temporary workaround: add route to 3.80.0.0/16 -> tgw-attach-xyz to reach control-plane without hijacking customer DB subnet. Documented in Confluence link above.

Performance tuning checklist:
- Reduce tokenization overhead: use token_cache=true on first 2 requests per session.
- KV cache warmup: run warmup endpoint with common prompts (see prompts/warmup-list.txt in repo).
- Quant profile: q5ctx performs well but under heavy batch shows increased CPU stalls; consider q4_0 for low-memory contexts.
- Autoscale: prefer step policy over target tracking for bursty jobs (customer usage pattern: short spikes).

Observed errors & notes:
- Error: "kv-cache-evict-failure" appears when Egress bandwidth saturates; hypothesize S3 latency causing long GC cycles on agent. Plan: instrument s3 client latencies on agent and add circuit breaker.
- Error: TLS handshake failure with internal control-plane on second attempt; root cause likely ALPN mismatch. Workaround applied on staging: forced TLS1.2 on rwd-agent; need prod-compatible fix.

Open questions (to ask customer or infra):
- Do they require full HSM signing of each model load, or only artifact signing at rest? (affects perf)
- Will Gullwing accept a dedicated control-plane peering, or must we route through their proxy?
- Which subnets are allowed for egress? Need clear CIDR allowlist for control-plane endpoints.

Runbook excerpt (first responder steps):
1) If model fails to load: check agent logs /var/log/rwd/agent.log for "model-open-error".
2) If p50 tail > 200ms: check batch queue length (rwdctl metrics --service <id>), reduce batch_size to 8 and re-run smoke test.
3) If checksum mismatch on model artifact: attempt aws s3 cp to local and run sha256sum; if mismatch, request re-upload and obtain uploader details.

Notes to self (rough):
- Keep TTL for log retention 30d for Gullwing (cheap) but increase to 90d if they want longer retention for audits.
- Create quick runbook snippet for CS to escalate to eng-sre: include rwdctl collect-diagnostics --ticket <id>.

Meeting action items (from 2026-03-09 call):
- Lina to confirm KMS key policy and provide ARN.
- Ethan to add memstats flag and run agent with profiling for 1h.
- Maya to send curated warmup prompt list to Gullwing SRE.
- Follow-up on ALPN TLS fix: create incident ticket and label as "tls-alpn-gullwing".

Last quick log (local test):
- 2026-03-10 09:22 UTC - warmup run 1: 250 sessions, 5 tokens avg, no errors.
- 2026-03-10 10:15 UTC - smoke run: p95 = 320ms, mem usage 72% per replica.

References / shortcuts:
- Ticket: SOL-1245 (onboarding checklist)
- PR: gullwing-quant-tune (github PR #32)
- Confluence page for architecture diagram: see linked artifacts

Random TODOs (low priority):
- [ ] Draft customer-friendly one-pager on quant tradeoffs (owner: Maya)
- [ ] Add gullwing warmup prompts to public repo (owner: Ethan)
- [ ] Clean up stale env vars in staging cluster

End of scratchpad.

-- maya
